clue.text: Rock music CD not causing bad behaviour

indicators.note: to rock something is to shake it about, so the following letters are tossed into a new order

parts.note: the three words taken letter for letter as the raw material

explanation.surface: A worry that loud rock music leads people to behave badly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock music' reads as one phrase, but 'Rock' is the instruction and 'music CD not' the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Misconduct is improper or unacceptable behaviour, a direct synonym for bad behaviour.

clue.text: Small report missing nothing in government department

parts.note: mini means small

indicators.note: missing means going without, so a letter is taken out of the word before it

parts.note: a news report is a story
nothing is zero, the round letter O

explanation.surface: A minor report has gone astray inside a government office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nothing' is the letter O, which is what the report goes without.
explanation.definitionFit: A ministry is a department of state headed by a minister, such as the Ministry of Defence.

clue.text: Father with new alarm

parts.note: to sire is to father, and a sire is a male parent
standard abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: A dad who has bought a brand-new alarm clock.
explanation.definitionFit: A siren is a device making a loud warning sound, as on an ambulance.

clue.text: Rendition of remote diva set to be exaggerated

indicators.note: a rendition is a fresh performance or version, so the letters that follow are rendered in a new order

parts.note: the three words taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A distant prima donna's performance is bound to be overblown.
explanation.definitionFit: To overestimate is to rate too highly, so an overestimated thing has been inflated beyond its true size.

clue.text: Credible reforms yielding right measure of intensity

indicators.note: to reform is to form again, so the remaining letters are rearranged
yielding means giving up, so the word gives up one of its letters

parts.note: taken as written
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Believable reforms that give a sound way of gauging how strong something is.
explanation.walkthrough: CREDIBLE gives up its R, and the leftover CEDIBLE is shuffled.
explanation.definitionFit: A decibel is the unit used to measure the loudness, or intensity, of sound.

clue.text: Criminal with contented sound turned over in bed

indicators.note: in places the reversed sound inside the word for the bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

indicators.note: turning something over flips it end to end, so the sound is read backwards

parts.note: a cat purrs when contented

explanation.surface: A crook who rolls over in bed making a contented noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Criminal as an adjective means dishonest or illegal, which is what corrupt means of an official.

clue.text: Saint in middle of appraising wine

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside another
the middle of a word is its central pair of letters, which are the ones kept

parts.note: the two central letters of the ten-letter word
ST is the abbreviation for saint

explanation.surface: A holy figure busy appraising a bottle of wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Asti is a sparkling white wine from the Piedmont region of Italy.

clue.text: Romanians working for republic

indicators.note: something working is in motion, so the letters are set moving into a new order

parts.note: taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: Romanians who have gone abroad to work for some republic.
explanation.definitionFit: San Marino is a tiny independent republic surrounded by Italy, one of the oldest in the world.

clue.text: Compound belonging to period identified

indicators.note: the letters belong to the words that follow, sitting within them

parts.note: found across the end of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: A chemical compound has been identified as belonging to a certain period.
explanation.definitionFit: An iodide is a chemical compound of iodine with another element or group.

clue.text: Daring entertainer versatile in part

indicators.note: only a part of the words is used, a run of letters inside them

parts.note: the end of the first word runs into the start of the second

explanation.surface: A versatile performer showing daring in one particular role.
explanation.definitionFit: Nerve as a noun means boldness or courage, the same as daring used as a noun.

clue.text: Rude article popular editor concealed

parts.note: curt means rudely brief
the indefinite article
in means fashionable or popular
ED is the abbreviation for editor

explanation.surface: An impolite, well-liked newspaper editor hid an offensive piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Curtained means screened off by a curtain, so hidden from view.

clue.text: Poet in east after a nap explored afresh

indicators.note: after says the compass point comes behind the next set of letters
afresh means done again from scratch, so all the letters are arranged anew

parts.note: taken letter for letter
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A poet in the East, after a nap, went exploring again.
explanation.walkthrough: The E sits after the other letters, and the whole lot is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Alexander Pope was an English poet of the eighteenth century, author of The Rape of the Lock.

clue.text: Film star arranged a lover's debut

parts.note: the sun is our nearest star

indicators.note: arranged means put in a new order, so the letters that follow are reordered

parts.note: taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A film star set up the first appearance of a lover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Film star' reads as one phrase, but 'Film' is the definition and 'star' the start of the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunset Boulevard is Billy Wilder's 1950 Hollywood movie starring Gloria Swanson.

clue.text: Twitch returning in actual performance

indicators.note: in places the reversed word inside the next one

parts.note: real means actual

indicators.note: returning means going back, so the word is read from end to start

parts.note: a tic is a nervous twitch

explanation.surface: A nervous twitch keeps coming back during a live performance.
explanation.definitionFit: A recital is a concert or reading given by a solo performer or small group.

clue.text: Scoundrel with acknowledgement of debt scheming strangely

parts.note: a cur is a contemptible man
an IOU is a written note saying I owe you
sly means cunning or scheming

explanation.surface: A rogue holding an IOU is plotting in an odd way.
explanation.definitionFit: Curiously means oddly or in a way that arouses interest, a synonym of strangely.

clue.text: Very sad soldier in vehicle in retreat

indicators.note: in puts one piece inside another
retreating means going backwards, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: a cart is a simple vehicle
a GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A miserable soldier in a vehicle as the army falls back.
explanation.definitionFit: Tragic means causing or marked by great sorrow, so extremely sad.

clue.text: Science fiction series beginning with reference to edge of knowledge

parts.note: a start is a beginning
re means with reference to, as in a letter heading

indicators.note: the edge of a word is its outermost letter, here the first one

parts.note: the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: A sci-fi show that begins by citing the frontier of human knowledge.
explanation.definitionFit: Star Trek is the long-running American science fiction franchise that began on television in 1966.

clue.text: Hesitation after proper introduction

indicators.note: after places the hesitation behind the word for proper

parts.note: prim means stiffly proper
er is the sound of hesitating

explanation.surface: An awkward pause after a very correct formal introduction.
explanation.definitionFit: A primer is an elementary textbook that introduces a subject to beginners.

clue.text: Italian dish ending in disaster? It's too complicated

indicators.note: the ending of the word is its final letter, the one kept

parts.note: the last letter of the word

indicators.note: complicated means tangled, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A cook's rice dish has ended badly because the recipe is too fiddly.
explanation.definitionFit: Risotto is an Italian dish of rice cooked slowly in stock.

clue.text: Endlessly horrible time in den

indicators.note: endlessly means without an end, so the final letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: hideous means horrible
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Someone stuck having an endlessly awful time in their den.
explanation.definitionFit: A hideout is a hiding place, and a den is a hidden lair or retreat.

clue.text: Devise alien axe

parts.note: to hatch a plan is to devise it
ET is the film alien

explanation.surface: Come up with an otherworldly axe.
explanation.definitionFit: A hatchet is a small axe with a short handle.

clue.text: Sacred songs in front of shrine sheltered by trees

indicators.note: something sheltered is covered, so the letter sits inside the other word

parts.note: palms are trees

indicators.note: the front of a word is its first letter

parts.note: the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: Hymns sung before a shrine shaded by trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Psalms are the sacred songs or hymns of the biblical Book of Psalms.

clue.text: Polar explorer adjusted his level, catching stray dog

parts.note: Robert Falcon Scott led the ill-fated expedition to the South Pole

indicators.note: catching means holding inside, so one piece is caught within another
adjusted means altered, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: his taken as written, and a level is a tier
to err is to stray from the right path

explanation.surface: A polar explorer changed his standing after picking up a stray dog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stray dog' reads as one phrase, but 'stray' is the verb ERR and 'dog' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The Scottish terrier, or Scottie, is a small wiry-coated breed of dog.

clue.text: Awful din that is not linked to major label

indicators.note: awful means a mess, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken letter for letter
i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A dreadful racket from a band that has no deal with a big record company.
explanation.definitionFit: Indie describes music or bands released independently, without a contract with one of the big record companies.

clue.text: Carry on with abandon, desperate

parts.note: to last is to continue or carry on
to ditch is to abandon

explanation.surface: Keep going with wild abandon, out of sheer desperation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'With abandon' looks like a set phrase, but 'abandon' is a verb here.
explanation.definitionFit: A last-ditch effort is a final desperate attempt to avoid defeat.

clue.text: Request kind direction

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to ask for something, as in a restaurant
second meaning: a sort or class, as in of the highest kind
third meaning: an instruction or command

explanation.surface: Ask for a kindly instruction.
explanation.walkthrough: Three separate meanings of one word sit side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Order serves as a verb for requesting, a noun for a class or sort, and a noun for a command.

clue.text: Protein from very variable area

parts.note: so means very, as in so good
algebra uses x, y and z as variables
A is the abbreviation for area

explanation.surface: Protein levels that vary widely from one region to another.
explanation.definitionFit: Soya beans are a major plant source of protein, used in tofu and meat substitutes.

clue.text: Courage, pet — it's a hold-up

parts.note: bottle is British slang for courage or nerve
to neck is to kiss and cuddle, as is to pet

explanation.surface: Someone's brave pet is causing a delay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pet' looks like an animal but is a verb meaning to kiss and cuddle.
explanation.definitionFit: A bottleneck is a narrow point that causes a delay, like a traffic jam.
